'\u003e'\n                                     : limit == fast ? '='\n                                                     : '\u003c'),\n                                    fast);\n          \n          standard_condition = (limit \u003c= fast);\n      }\n  }\n\n  // Step 4: Override Standard TRUE (Extend Burst)\n  if (standard_condition) {\n      if (laminar && consecutive_skips \u003c 5) {\n          consecutive_skips++;\n          kissat_extremely_verbose (solver, \n                                    \"Laminar search: skipping restart (var %.2f, skip %d)\", \n                                    lbd_var_ema, consecutive_skips);\n          return false;\n      }\n      consecutive_skips = 0;\n      return true;\n  }\n\n  // Step 5: Override Standard FALSE (Force Restart)\n  if (!standard_condition) {\n      if (turbulent) {\n          kissat_extremely_verbose (solver, \n                                    \"Turbulent search: forcing restart (var %.2f)\", \n                                    lbd_var_ema);\n          consecutive_skips = 0;\n          return true;\n      }\n  }\n\n  return false;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}],"role":"model"},"finishReason":"STOP"}],"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","usageMetadata":{"candidatesTokenCount":894,"thoughtsTokenCount":10424,"promptTokenCount":6050,"promptTokensDetails":[{"tokenCount":6050,"modality":"TEXT"}],"totalTokenCount":17368}},"key":"req-0001"}
